title: Copyright Waffle on the radio
content:
We were delighted to be asked to pre-record a radio show for ALTc Radio by my colleague Dom Pates. The Association for Learning Technology’s conference (ALTc) is taking place in Cardiff this week and running alongside it is a radio show with exclusive content and live feeds from the conference.

Our show features a selection of tunes that we like and have meaning to us – of course there is a link to copyright as well in many cases. Chris and I had great fun recording the session and testing out some new kit. As a big Traitors fan, I love the visualised podcast and so it was fun setting up my lounge to look a little like this! The full radio schedule is available in the graphic below. However our session is going out live tomorrow (Wednesday 21st October) at 11-12pm. So do tune in and have a listen for some copyright waffle and some of our favourite tunes!
